film.title: Dirty Harry
S: Six shots or five jalapeño poppers
Did he fire six shots or only five

Mix the cream cheese, cheddar and spring onion and fill each jalapeño half. Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko. Chill for 10 minutes. Fry at 180C in batches until golden, about 3 minutes, and drain. Stir the sour cream, mayo and herbs for a quick ranch and serve alongside.
Harry finds Scorpio at Kezar Stadium

Cut the dough into 8, roll into long ropes and twist into pretzel shapes. Bring the water and bicarb to the boil and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds, then lift onto a lined tray. Brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake at 220C until deep brown. Cook the butter and flour, whisk in the milk until thick, then melt in the cheddar. Serve the pretzels warm with the cheese sauce and mustard.
M: Harry gets one bite of lunch

Brown the mince with one of the onions and the garlic, breaking it up very fine. Stir in the chilli powder, cumin and tomato paste, add the water and simmer until thick. Grill the franks until blistered and warm the rolls. Load each roll with a frank, a ladle of chilli, mustard, the rest of the raw onion and cheddar.
W: Harry throws his badge in the water

Heat the cream, golden syrup and butter until steaming, then stir in the chocolate until glossy. Toast the almonds in a dry pan. Scoop the ice cream into glasses, pour over the hot fudge and top with whipped cream, almonds and a cherry.
K: Harry asks the punk if he feels lucky

Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water, then tip it out. Stir a teaspoon of sugar and 40ml whiskey into each, then fill with hot coffee. Whip the cream until just thick and float it over the back of a spoon.
film.T: One bite in. Then the alarm.
film.D: A San Francisco inspector with a .44 Magnum and no time for the rule book hunts a sniper who calls himself Scorpio.
film.P: Serve the hot dogs when Harry orders the usual and clocks the tan Ford outside the bank.
